# Athena release notes

Apply the [ASD-STE100 technical-English policy](../skills/TECHNICAL_ENGLISH.md) to all English
technical prose in the release notes.

Install Athena through its Git-backed skill or plugin source. Installation and invocation commands
depend on the coding harness. The root [`README.md`](../README.md) gives the general instructions.

Each release includes a checksummed portable plugin archive. Use it for offline distribution and
provenance.

The archive contains only these items:

- skills that coding harnesses use;
- host manifests and marketplace metadata;
- runtime documentation;
- assets; and
- legal notices.

The archive excludes these items:

- tests;
- repository scripts;
- development manifests and lockfiles;
- task-runner files;
- continuous integration (CI) configuration;
- caches; and
- generated development output.

The archive is not a Python package. It does not replace a Git-backed marketplace installation.


## What's Changed
* Add a bounded two-sided review exchange by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/229
* fix(pr-review): resolve verified native comment identifiers by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/231
* fix(pr-review): verify retained native context anchors by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/233
* fix(pr-review): separate native adoption from thread ownership by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/235
* fix(review-exchange): accept a final fence at end of input by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/239
* fix(pr-review): bind summary anchors to original source by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/240
* fix(review-exchange): admit native findings in corrective rounds by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/242
* fix(pr-review): verify corrective historical witnesses by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/244
* fix(pr-review): accept trailing anchor whitespace by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/247
* fix(review-exchange): encode oversized carriers losslessly by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/248
* fix(pr-review): keep changed-path scope stable by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/252
* fix(pr-review): keep delivery valid after target movement by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/253
* fix(pr-review): supersede one malformed historical carrier by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/255
* fix(issue-review): recover one authorized historical carrier by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/257
* docs(review): clarify review after a completed older-head GO by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/262
* fix(review): recover one historical inline root by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/263
* fix: use publication time for inline root recovery by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/264
* fix(pr-review): bound linked comment page size by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/267
* fix(learn): deliver direct learn requests by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/268
* fix(pr-review): resume delivery with verified completed history by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/269
* fix(review-exchange): reframe imported legacy plans by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/272
* Decouple reviews from validation by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/270
* chore(release): prepare v0.5.3 by @mvillmow in https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/pull/273


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HomericIntelligence/Athena/compare/v0.5.2...v0.5.3

# Athena release notes

Install Athena through its Git-backed skill or plugin source. The concrete installation and
invocation commands depend on the coding harness and are described generically in the root
[`README.md`](../README.md).

Each release includes a checksummed portable plugin archive for offline distribution and provenance.
It contains only harness-consumed skills, host manifests and marketplace metadata, runtime

output. The archive is not a Python package and does not replace Git-backed marketplace
installation.
